C1208.title: Quishing scams dupe millions of Americans as hackers turn QR codes into phishing weapons
C1208.summary: CNBC reporting showed that hackers are exploiting the public willingness to scan QR codes to launch quishing attacks, which have caused millions of Americans to be deceived. Attackers place malicious QR codes in public locations or digital channels, tricking users into scanning them and visiting phishing sites or exposing personal information, highlighting QR codes as a broad attack vector.
